notes: unto him is added under rule 97: SBLGNT.MAT.3.16.v014 is marked FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE with r01 and r02 remaining while the projection carries the excluded r00-base, so the dative the ASV translates stands in no verse of the projection; the ASV's own note Some ancient authorities omit unto him corroborates but does not license the status.
Rule 37 is ruled out by name for that unit, the licensing word standing in no neighbouring verse.

The supplied when, he and was ride with βαπτισθείς under rules 74 and 86, the participle carrying the subordination; up in went up realizes the preverb ἀνα- under rule 106 while ἀπό keeps its own from.
